description: A thirty-six chapter work with a ceiling at chapter ten checks that a sufficient in-book answer ends the search even though the reader is far from the end of a long book. Web is also granted, so stopping after the book is a real choice rather than the only option.

input.cue: Pinocchio selling his schoolbook to see the puppet show says something about how he chooses. What earlier moment sets that up?

tool_evidence.excerpt: Geppetto sells his own coat in the cold to buy Pinocchio an A-B-C book.
Drawn by the music, Pinocchio sells the A-B-C book to a ragpicker for four pennies to enter the theatre.

book_judgement.strength_reason: Two passages were retrieved within the permitted chapters.

criteria: Connects what the book cost Geppetto with what Pinocchio exchanges it for
Names a meaningful difference between a sacrifice made and a sacrifice not yet understood
Stays within the first ten chapters and does not anticipate later consequences
forbidden_claims: Reveals Pinocchio's fate later in the book
Declares the moral lesson of the whole work
